context: Last call at a bar Kenji, Daichi, and Aoi all know. Aoi is doing closing; Kenji and Daichi are the last two customers.
purpose: three-way bar moment — friends + service-friend, final-cup intimacy

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: もう少しで、ラストオーダーです。
lines.style: Even, professional tone with underlying warmth. Hands moving naturally. Matter-of-fact but not rushed. The rhythm of closing time, familiar.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: あおいちゃん、一杯、私らと飲み？
lines.en: Aoi-chan — come have one with us, yeah?
lines.style: Warm Kansai lilt, playful without pressure. A genuine half-laugh underneath. The tone of someone who asks without needing the answer to be yes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: (small laugh) 仕事中だから、本当に、無理です。
lines.en: (small laugh) I'm working, so really — I can't.
lines.style: A small, genuine laugh — not forced or apologetic. Warm refusal. Polite without stiffness. The ease of saying no to people she likes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: まあな、無理言うな、ダイチ。
lines.en: Come on, don't put her in that spot, Daichi.
lines.style: Steady, quiet correction from someone with seniority. Not sharp — just a gentle redirect. Voice carries his attentive presence, his eye on both of them.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: はいはい、すまんすまん。
lines.style: Kansai-flavored self-deprecation. A half-laugh, no edge to it. The ease of backing off because it's not a fight he needs to have.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当に、お二人、よく来てくださって。
lines.en: You two really — thank you for coming so often.
lines.style: Genuine, unperformed gratitude. Voice dips slightly on the thank-you. She's sliding their drinks across, present in the moment. Sincere without weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ。…今日は、特に助かった。
lines.en: Same to you. …Today especially — it really helped.
lines.style: A small unguarded moment. Voice carries real weight here, not covering anything up. He means it fully. A breath of honesty in the small closing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いつでも、来てくださいね。
lines.style: Warm, low-voiced send-off. Simple and direct. The tone of someone who means an open door, not a polite phrase.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: あおいちゃん、ほんま、ありがとう。
lines.style: Full Kansai warmth and gratitude. Unhurried, genuine. The tone of someone saying goodbye to someone who matters, without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 時間、引き止めてすみません。お疲れさまです。
lines.en: Sorry for keeping you past closing. Thank you for your work today.
lines.style: Considerate and genuine throughout. Quiet respect in the delivery. The man who notices he's taken her time and honors it. No rush in the goodbye.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 大丈夫です。…お気をつけて、お帰りを。
lines.en: It's fine. …Get home safely, you two.
lines.style: Warm, steady send-off. Quiet but present. The voice of someone who notices and cares about the people leaving her counter. Simple kindness.
